title: Complete Bounded Repair Ports: Transfer, Reliability, and Geometric Structure
description: This preprint studies the complete bounded repair port of a linear code at a distinguished coordinate: the family of all bounded dual-support repairs together with their normalized scalar coefficients and helper-failure reliability. It proves that the minimum coefficient port of an MDS code reconstructs the represented code, gives an exact weighted-functional transfer theorem for concatenation, and realizes every fixed represented port satisfying the pointed obstruction bound with positive density in an asymptotically good fixed-alphabet family. It also develops deletion-contraction reliability and bounded-EXIT calculi, identifies full-radius reliability with a specialization of the Las Vergnas polynomial of an elementary matroid perspective, and proves that the bounded-radius filtration contains additional information. Twisted-cubic-axis and quartic-normal-rational-curve nucleus codes in characteristic three provide geometric applications, including a harmonic Steiner repair port.
